status: INTERNAL HEURISTIC CANDIDATE — NOT APPROVED FOR RUNTIME OR RELEASE

intended_use.purpose: An internal, exact and replayable candidate for a future product ingredient_goodness_percent under a declared abstract product composition.
intended_use.audience_scope: Broad, general and non-personal informational food guidance only.
non_claims: Not a medical, clinical, therapeutic, personal dietary, dose, frequency or portion recommendation.
Not a safety, regulatory-compliance, certification or individual-suitability statement.
Not a nutrition score or an overall product score.
Not independently validated and not authorized for runtime or release.

upstream_dependencies.mapping_mvp: Mapping Option A — ordinal lookup based on internal profiles and traceable reference judgments
upstream_dependencies.policy_architecture: Policy Option C — Layered state model
upstream_dependencies.future_mapping_option: Mapping Option B — possible multi-attribute development only

input_invariants: A computable entry carries one integer ingredient_score in 0..100; other states carry no score member.
Each applicable entry has a unique contribution_identity_key after governed relationship resolution.
Raw quantity, QUID and order information are preserved as provenance/disclosure and are not numerical inputs in V1.
Confidence, uncertainty, coverage, missingness, criticality, hazard, exposure, risk, regulatory status, ontology labels and informational flags are non-numeric disclosures.

stage_1_product_perimeter.if: no applicable entries remain after explicit non_applicable entries are separated

stage_2_evidence_and_identity_gate.if: any applicable entry has ingredient_result_state == not_computable
any applicable entry has relationship_state != resolved

stage_3_numeric_candidate.precondition: Every applicable entry is computable, relationship-resolved and uniquely represented.
stage_3_numeric_candidate.expression: ingredient_goodness_percent = round_half_even((sum of applicable ingredient_score integers) / applicable entry count)
stage_3_numeric_candidate.arithmetic: Exact integer numerator and exact rational denominator; floating point is forbidden; terminal result is a JSON integer in 0..100.

quantity_and_order_boundary.per_entry_contribution_policy: The formula deliberately assigns one equal arithmetic contribution to each eligible entry. This is an internal MVP heuristic contribution policy for broad informational food guidance only, not a physical quantity model and not a final approved aggregation method.
quantity_and_order_boundary.rule: Missing quantity is neither zero, absence, an equal known physical quantity nor a reliable quantity denominator. The V1 arithmetic denominator is a count of eligible entries, not a quantity denominator.
non_inferences: Equal per-entry contribution does not mean equal mass.
Equal per-entry contribution does not mean equal exposure, risk, nutritional importance or scientific importance.
Quantity, QUID and order remain disclosure, provenance and support fields only.
quantity_and_order_boundary.limitation: The candidate is quantity-blind and order-blind by design. Its per-entry contribution policy is acceptable only as an Internal Informational Assurance candidate while PSC-OD-006 remains OPEN; reliable quantity or order rules require a separate future decision and review.

separation_controls.coverage_and_evaluability: Reported independently. Coverage labels do not multiply, penalize, impute or otherwise alter a computable numeric result.
separation_controls.nutrition_boundary: Nutrition properties and nutrition scores are excluded from inputs, formula and output; nutrition_overlap is disclosure-only.

output_contract.zero_rule: ingredient_goodness_percent=0 is a valid computable numeric endpoint and never represents missingness, not_computable or non_applicable.

disclosure_contract.presentation_rule: Disclosures accompany, but do not contribute to, the candidate number.

provenance_and_replay.determinism: Identical canonical input, candidate version and source cutoff must yield the same status, output and digests.

canonical_serialization_and_digest.scope: Complete JSON value excluding only integrity.canonical_digest_sha256.
rules: Sort object keys recursively by Unicode code point.
Use minimal JSON integers and lowercase literals; floats, exponent notation, leading zeros and negative zero are forbidden.
Encode UTF-8 without BOM and no insignificant whitespace.
Hash canonical UTF-8 bytes with SHA-256 in lowercase hexadecimal.

known_limitations: Quantity-blind unless future quantity evidence and a separate decision support its use.
Order-blind unless future order rules are separately approved.
Sensitive to duplicate representation; V1 blocks rather than resolves duplicate/proxy cases.
Internal heuristic only; not externally validated.
No personal context, medical interpretation, nutrition score or overall score is modeled.
